fastspawner.particle.name: Spawner Particle
fastspawner.particle.tooltip: Modify this to control the rendering percentage of the spawners' Fire & Smoke particle. Generally this is not very important unless there are many spawners around you.
fastspawner.shift.name: Shift To Show Spawner Internal Entity
fastspawner.shift.tooltip: If true, entities inside spawners will be rendered when player holds Shift. If false, they will never be rendered anymore.
